node.statement: Fix arbitrary W,A,w,U,V,R,v_U,v_V satisfying the root hypotheses for the witnesses chosen in 1.1. Since W.e_cross <= e_cross^0 <= e_*, every hypothesis of lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum holds. That lemma therefore furnishes in A_R its explicit Stage-3 amplified four-corner datum, with common defect rho <= C_cross^0*t, using the nested-corner, outer-compression, compressed-corner-unit-comparison, and zero-cross-corner constructions.
